clues: Cassiobury Park, once the estate of the Earls of Essex, is its largest park.
Elton John has twice been chairman of its football club.
A former aircraft-engine factory on its northern edge became film studios in the 1990s.
GoldenEye and Star Wars: The Phantom Menace were shot at those studios.
The Harry Potter studio tour at Leavesden is just north of this Hertfordshire town.
